Defects of tyrosine metabolism
Restriction of phenylalanine and
tyrosine, and methionine (only if
prolonged hypermethioninemia is
observed). Low phenylalanine and
tyrosine containing formula. Optimal
protein diet.
To monitor plasma amino acid proﬁle.
To normalize plasma tyrosine and
ensure normal growth.

supplementation of downstream
nutrients.
